description: VAD and speaker embedding share the audio worker. An embedding failure resets the worker; ensureEmbedding reloads only the embedder, so the next vad.push throws 'VAD not loaded', feedVad sets ready.vad=false and live captions stop for the rest of the run with no retry. VAD failures have no recovery path at all (STT and embeddings do). Found during irl-subt-9ij.16.
title: Live VAD never recovers after an audio-worker reset
